cause_quote:
The commit that introduced the session companion rail rendered pending replies with `
${t("chat.rail.askPending")}
`.
user_saw: While Side chat prepared a reply, users saw “Answering from this session…” in place of the working indicator and elapsed timer shown in the main chat.
summary: The fix switches pending Side chat replies to the shared working indicator and records when each turn started so the elapsed timer survives panel remounts.
reasoning: The introducing diff shows that the session companion rail shipped with a text-only pending state while the main transcript already had a working indicator. I checked the older Side chat panel, which also used a text hint, and confirmed that the later Solid migration preserved the rail’s text-only behavior.
